861: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸੋ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ, ਨਿਤ ਕਰ ਜੁਰਨਾ ॥
O my mind, ever meditate, with palms humbly joined, on the One from whom you receive all comforts.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਨਿਤ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਹਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
O Lord, grant servant Nanak this one gift: that Your feet may ever dwell in my heart. ॥4॥3॥
ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ. ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ; ਸਭਿ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਝੂਠੁ, ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
All the kings, emperors, nobles, chiefs and headmen are perishable; know such love of Maya to be false.
ਹਰਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ. ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ; ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਭਜੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
The Lord alone is imperishable, eternal and unmoving; O my mind, meditate on Him and be accepted. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਭਜੁ; ਸਦਾ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
O my mind, meditate on the Lord's Name; it is the everlasting support.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who attains a dwelling at the Lord's feet through the Guru's Word, no one's strength equals his spiritual strength. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਿਤਨੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਕੁਲਵੰਤ ਮਿਲਖਵੰਤ ਦੀਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਸਭਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ. ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਕਚਾਣੁ ॥
O my mind, all the wealthy, the high-born and the landowners you see will perish; their greatness is as fleeting as the colour of safflower.
ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੇਵਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
O my mind, ever serve the True, Immaculate Lord, through whom you will receive honour in His court. ॥2॥
ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੂਦ ਵੈਸ. ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ, ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹਹਿ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ. ਸੋ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
There are four castes, Brahmin, Khatri, Shudra and Vaish, and four stages of life; whoever meditates on the Lord is the most exalted of them.
ਜਿਉ ਚੰਦਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਿਰਡੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਤਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ. ਪਤਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
As the poor castor plant growing near sandalwood becomes fragrant, so even the sinner, joining the holy congregation, is made pure and accepted. ॥3॥
ਓਹੁ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ. ਸਭ ਤੇ ਸੂਚਾ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥
The one in whose heart the Lord comes to dwell becomes highest of all and purest of all.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੈ; ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ. ਨੀਚੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਸੇਵਕਾਣੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
Servant Nanak washes the feet of the Lord's servant and devotee, even if he is counted low in caste. ॥4॥4॥
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭਤੈ ਵਰਤੈ; ਜੇਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਏ, ਤੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਕਰਈਐ ॥
The Lord, the Knower of hearts, pervades everywhere; as the Lord has one act, so one acts.
ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਦਾ, ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਜੋ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਰਖਿ ਲਈਐ ॥੧॥
So, O my mind, ever serve such a Lord, who can protect you from everything. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਪੜਈਐ ॥
O my mind, chant the Lord's Name; ever utter the Lord's Name.
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋ ਮਾਰਿ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ; ਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਇਤੁ ਕੜਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Since none but the Lord can kill or give life, O my mind, why worry? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਰਤੈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਧਰਈਐ ॥
The Creator Lord made this whole visible world, and Himself placed His own light within it.
ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਬੋਲੈ. ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਬੁਲਾਏ; ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਈਐ ॥੨॥
The One Lord Himself speaks in all, and the One Lord gives all the power to speak; the perfect Guru has shown me the One Lord everywhere. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ. ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ; ਕਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮਨ. ਕਿਆ ਚੋਰਈਐ ॥
The Lord is with us within, and with us without; tell me, O mind, what can be hidden from Him?
ਨਿਹਕਪਟ ਸੇਵਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੀ; ਤਾਂ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ. ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਈਐ ॥੩॥
Serve the Lord without deceit; then, O my mind, you will receive all comforts. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ, ਸੋ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡਾ; ਸੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਅਈਐ ॥
The One in whose control everything lies is the greatest of all; O my mind, ever meditate on Him.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ, ਤੁਧੁ ਲਏ ਛਡਈਐ ॥੪॥੫॥
Servant Nanak, that Lord is ever with you; meditate on Him always, and He will set you free. ॥4॥5॥
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਹੁ ਤਪਤੈ; ਜਿਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਵੰਤੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨੀਰ ॥੧॥
My mind burns with longing for the Lord's sight, like a thirsty man without water. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ; ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਗੋ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰ ॥
Love for the Lord has pierced my mind like an arrow.
ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Lord God alone knows my anguish, the pain deep within my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਭਾਈ. ਸੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੀਰ ॥੨॥
Whoever tells me something of my Beloved Lord is my brother, my dear brother. ॥2॥
862: ਮਿਲੁ ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ. ਗੁਣ ਕਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ; ਲੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੩॥
Come, come, my friend, taking the Guru's calming counsel, and tell me the praises of my God. ॥3॥
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ. ਹਰਿ ਆਸ ਪੁਜਾਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੪॥੬॥ ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
O Lord, fulfil servant Nanak's hope; through Your sight my heart finds peace. ॥4॥6॥ Chhaka 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The Lord is the Creator of all, and the Enjoyer of all. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Creator is the one who hears, the Creator is the one who sees.
The Creator is the unseen, the Creator is the seen.
The Creator is the One who creates, the Creator is the One who destroys.
The Creator pervades all, and the Creator is unattached. ॥1॥
The Creator is the speaker, the Creator is the one who understands.
The Creator comes into the world, and the Creator also departs.
The Creator is beyond the three qualities, and the Creator is with them.
By the Guru's grace, Nanak, one sees Him alike in all. ॥2॥1॥
ਫਾਕਿਓ. ਮੀਨ ਕਪਿਕ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ; ਤੂ ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ. ਕੁਸੰਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
O mind, you are caught like the fish and the monkey; you are entangled in the fleeting safflower of Maya.
ਪਗ ਧਾਰਹਿ. ਸਾਸੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਲੈ; ਤਉ ਉਧਰਹਿ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
Every step you take and every breath you draw is counted; only by singing the Lord's praises will you be saved. ॥1॥
O mind, come to your senses and give up your waywardness.
ਅਪਨੇ ਰਹਨ ਕਉ ਠਉਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਕਾਏ. ਪਰ ਕੈ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You will find no lasting place to stay here; why then go after others' wealth? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਰਿਓ; ਤੂ ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬਾਇਲੇ ॥
As the elephant is driven by lust, so you are caught in attachment to family.
ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਿਛੁਰੈ; ਥਿਰੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ. ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਲੇ ॥੨॥
As birds gather on a tree and then part, so all family must part; joining the holy company, meditate on the Lord, the lasting abode. ॥2॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਮੀਨੁ ਰਸਨ ਸਾਦਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ; ਓਹੁ ਮੂਠੌ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਭਾਇਲੇ ॥
As the fish perishes for the taste of its tongue, the fool robbed by its greed,
ਤੂ ਹੋਆ ਪੰਚ ਵਾਸਿ ਵੈਰੀ ਕੈ; ਛੂਟਹਿ ਪਰੁ ਸਰਨਾਇਲੇ ॥੩॥
so you have fallen under the power of the five enemies; only by seeking the Lord's refuge will you be freed. ॥3॥
ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ. ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ; ਸਭਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤਾਇਲੇ ॥
O Destroyer of the sorrows of the meek, be merciful; all beings and creatures are Yours.
ਪਾਵਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਾ; ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Meet Nanak, the servant of Your servants; may I ever behold Your sight; this is the one gift I ask. ॥4॥2॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The One who fashioned you and gave you soul and breath,
who in mercy placed His light in the body of clay,
ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਭੋਜਨ ਭੋਗਾਇ ॥
who gave you everything to use and feeds you many kinds of food,
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ; ਮੂੜੇ ਕਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
forsaking that God, O fool, where do you wander? ॥1॥
I want to be committed to the service of the Supreme Lord.
ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਝੈ; ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only from the Guru comes understanding of the Immaculate, luminous Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
The One who created forms of countless kinds,
who can create and destroy in the blink of an eye,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਹੀ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
whose state and extent cannot be told,
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ; ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
O my mind, ever meditate on that God. ॥2॥
He neither comes nor goes; the Master is eternal and unmoving.
ਬੇਅੰਤ ਗੁਨਾ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀ ॥
His virtues are countless; how many of them can I count?
863: ਲਾਲ ਨਾਮ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
His storehouses are full of the rubies of His virtues.
He gives support to all beings. ॥3॥
ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
He whose very Name tells that He is the eternal, all-pervading Being,
ਮਿਟਹਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਅਘ; ਨਿਮਖ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
sing His praise at every moment, and millions of sins are erased.
He is the companion of all from the beginning, the friend of His devotees,
the support of the breath of life; Nanak, cherish love for Him in your heart. ॥4॥1॥3॥
Now I trade in the Name,
ਨਾਮੋੁ ਹੀ; ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
and the Name alone has become the support of this mind.
I have made the Name alone the shelter of my heart.
Repeating the Name, millions of sins are erased. ॥1॥
The Guru has given me the Lord's Name alone as my capital.
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਇਸਟੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Name has become my mind's most cherished deity; but attention to it comes only in the Guru's company. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Name has become the wealth of my soul;
the Name is my companion wherever I go.
The Name alone seems sweet to my mind.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਨਾਮੋ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੨॥
In water, on land, and in all beings I see the Name alone, the Lord. ॥2॥
Through the Name one's face is radiant in the Lord's court;
through the Name all one's family lines are saved.
Joined to the Name, all my affairs succeed.
Now this mind of mine has grown attached to the Name. ॥3॥
Through the Name alone I have become fearless;
through the Name my comings and goings have ended.
The perfect Guru has united me with the Lord, the treasure of virtues.
Nanak says: through the Name one dwells in peace and spiritual poise. ॥4॥2॥4॥
The One who gives honour to the dishonoured,
who gives sustenance to all the hungry,
who is able to protect in the terrible womb,
ever bow in reverence to that Master. ॥1॥
Meditate in your mind on such a God,
ਘਟਿ ਅਵਘਟਿ; ਜਤ ਕਤਹਿ ਸਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
who helps everywhere, within the body and outside it. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਰੰਕੁ ਰਾਉ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
In whose eyes beggar and king are alike,
who pervades all, the worm and the elephant,
who consults no one else for advice,
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ; ਸੁ ਆਪਹਿ ਕਰੈ ॥੨॥
but whatever He does, He does Himself. ॥2॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one will ever know the limit of His being.
The Immaculate Lord Himself is everything, everywhere.
He Himself is all form, and He Himself is formless.
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਘਟਿ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
He is in every heart, and the support of all hearts. ॥3॥
The devotees are dyed deep red in the love of His Name.
Singing His praise, the saints ever blossom with joy.
In the love of the Name the Lord's servants stay sated, free of craving for Maya.
Nanak falls at the feet of those servants. ॥4॥3॥5॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ॥
My friends are the saints in whose company this mind becomes pure,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ॥
in whose company the Lord's Name is ever remembered,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
in whose company all sins are destroyed,
and in whose company the heart is lit with spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਸੇ ਸੰਤਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Those saints of the Lord are my friends,
ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਾਈਐ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in whose company only the Name is ever sung. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
Through whose teaching the Lord's Name comes to dwell in the mind,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ; ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਨਸੈ ॥
through whose instruction every fear and doubt flees,
in whose hearts dwells the sublime, purifying praise of the Lord,
and the dust of whose feet the whole world longs for. ॥2॥
ਕੋਟਿ ਪਤਿਤ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰ ॥
In whose company millions of sinners are saved from vice,
ਏਕੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
in whose hearts the One Formless Lord alone dwells, whose support is His Name,
the Lord who knows the secrets of all beings,
the treasure of mercy, the Immaculate, luminous Lord. ॥3॥
When the Supreme Lord became merciful,
then I met the merciful Guru, the saint.
864: In such company Nanak meditates on the Name day and night,
and through the Lord's Name there is peace, poise and bliss within. ॥4॥4॥6॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
The Guru's image, his Word, is the focus of meditation in my mind.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ; ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨ ॥
Through the Guru's Word my mind accepts the mantra of the Name.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਾਰਉ ॥
I enshrine the Guru's feet in my heart.
Knowing the Guru as the form of the Supreme Lord, I ever bow to him. ॥1॥
Let no one in the world, straying in doubt, forget
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ; ਨ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that without the Guru no one can cross over. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Guru has set the one who strayed on the right path,
turned him from other worship and joined him to devotion to the Lord,
and ended his fear of birth and death.
The greatness of the perfect Guru is boundless. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace the inverted lotus of the heart turns upright and blossoms,
and in the pitch darkness of attachment the light of spiritual life shines.
ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
Through the Guru one comes to know the One who created all.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace the foolish mind grows accustomed to the Lord's feet. ॥3॥
The Guru is the form of the Creator, able to do all.
The Guru is the form of the Transcendent Lord, who is and ever will be.
Nanak says: God has made me understand this:
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ; ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥
without the Guru, O brother, liberation is not attained. ॥4॥5॥7॥
ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ; ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
O my mind, remember the Guru, the Guru, the Guru at all times.
I see no support but the Guru.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਰਹਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Day and night stay in the support of the Guru,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੋਇ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੧॥
whose gift of spiritual life no one can erase. ॥1॥
Know the Guru and the Transcendent Lord as one.
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whatever pleases the Lord, the Guru too accepts. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
The one whose mind is attached to the Guru's feet,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
his pain, sorrow and doubt all flee.
Through the Guru's service one receives honour everywhere.
O my mind, be ever a sacrifice to the Guru. ॥2॥
Beholding the Guru's sight, one is enraptured.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ; ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ॥
The labour of the Guru's servant is fruitful.
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ; ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
No sorrow can overpower the Guru's servant.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੩॥
The Guru's servant becomes known in all ten directions. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Guru's glory cannot be described.
The Guru is the form of the Supreme Lord who pervades all.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਭਾਗ ॥
Nanak says: the one whose destiny is full,
ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥੪॥੬॥੮॥
his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ॥4॥6॥8॥
The Guru is my worship; the Guru is the form of the Lord of the universe.
My Guru is the form of the Supreme Lord; the Guru is mighty.
My Guru is the form of the luminous Lord, indescribable and unfathomable.
I stay in the refuge of the Guru's feet, which all creation worships. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਥਾਉ ॥
Without the Guru I see no other place of shelter.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਉ; ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
At all times I repeat the Guru's name, the Guru's. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ; ਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
The Guru is my spiritual wisdom; the Guru dwelling in my heart is my meditation.
The Guru is the form of the all-pervading Lord, the Sustainer of the world.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਰਹਉ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
With palms joined I stay in the Guru's refuge.
I see no support but the Guru. ॥2॥
The Guru is the ship that carries one across the world-ocean.
In the Guru's refuge there is release from the fear of Death.
In the pitch darkness of attachment the Guru's teaching gives light.
In the Guru's company all are carried across. ॥3॥
The perfect Guru is found by great fortune.
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
In the Guru's refuge no sorrow can touch one.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one can erase the light of the Guru's Word from the heart in which it dwells.
Guru Nanak is the form of the Lord Himself. ॥4॥7॥9॥
865: Trade in remembrance with the capital of the Lord's Name.
Make the Lord's Name the support of your life.
Ever sing the praises of the Lord,
the all-pervading Lord who is present in all creation. ॥1॥
Joining the saints, chant the Lord's Name.
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਮਲ; ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This is the purest and most fruitful of all deeds. ॥1॥ Rahao
Gather the wealth of the Lord's Name and fill your storehouses.
Make the Lord's Name the food of your soul.
Take care that the Lord's Name is never forgotten;
the Guru in his mercy has told me this. ॥2॥
The Lord is ever our helper;
keep your attention ever fixed on Him.
Repeating the Lord's Name, beings become pure,
and the sins of many births depart. ॥3॥
Remembering the Lord, He ends the cycle of birth and death.
Uttering His Name, He carries one across the fearful world-ocean.
Light within you the radiance of the Lord, the highest of all.
O servant Nanak, repeat His Name night and day. ॥4॥8॥10॥
When the Master restrained the five chiefs, they admitted defeat before His servants.
Through His servants the Lord struck them down and drove them away.
ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤ ਕਾ; ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
They could not find the dwelling of the Lord's devotees,
for the Lord's servants, joining together, have ever sung the song of His praise. ॥1॥
Lust, anger, greed, attachment and pride, the five chiefs of the whole world,
are the water-carriers of the Lord's devotees. ॥1॥ Rahao
They take tribute from the world,
but they bow in salute to the Lord's devotees.
They rob the faithless of their spiritual wealth, and the faithless lose their honour,
ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ; ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਹਿ ॥੨॥
but they massage and wash the feet of the holy. ॥2॥
One mother, Maya, gave birth to these five sons.
By the Lord's command Maya, staging the play of the sources of life, brought forth the world.
ਤੀਨਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਰਚਿ ਰਸੇ ॥
People are absorbed in the three qualities of Maya and revel in them.
ਇਨ ਕਉ ਛੋਡਿ; ਊਪਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਸੇ ॥੩॥
Leaving these behind, the Lord's servants dwell in the higher realm of the spirit. ॥3॥
In His mercy the Lord has saved His servants from them.
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਸੇ; ਤਿਨਿ ਰਖੇ ਹਟਾਇ ॥
They belong to Him who made them, and He has held them back from His saints.
Nanak says: practise devotion to God;
without devotion the whole world is ruined. ॥4॥9॥11॥
Through the Lord's Name strife and suffering are erased.
Sorrows are destroyed, and peace makes its home within.
Repeating again and again the life-giving Name, the saints are sated from craving.
By the Guru's grace they receive all fruits. ॥1॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, His servants cross over.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The sins of many births are removed. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ; ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
The saints enshrine the Guru's feet in their hearts,
and so cross over the sea of the fire of craving.
All the turmoil of birth and death is ended,
and in spiritual poise their attention stays absorbed in God. ॥2॥
The One Master pervades every place,
the Knower of the hearts of all beings.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
The one to whom He mercifully gives understanding
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਲੇਇ ॥੩॥
repeats God's Name at all hours. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
The one within whom God Himself becomes manifest,
in his heart the light of spiritual life shines.
With loving devotion, sing the praises of the Lord.
Nanak, meditating on the Supreme Lord, one is carried across. ॥4॥10॥12॥
866: Bow your head at the Guru's lotus feet.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ; ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
By his grace, kill lust and anger within this body.
Live as the dust of the feet of all.
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
See the beautiful Lord dwelling in every heart, in all beings. ॥1॥
In this way, dwell on the Lord of the world, the Sustainer of the universe:
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
know body and wealth as God's gift, and this life as God's too. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
At all hours sing the Lord's praises.
This is the purpose of your life and breath.
Give up pride and know God to be with you.
ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੨॥
By the Guru's grace, dye your mind with the Lord's love. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕੀਆ; ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
Form a bond with the One who created you,
and you will receive honour in His court hereafter.
Mind and body become pure, and one is in bliss,
when the tongue repeats the Name of the Lord of the world. ॥3॥
Be merciful, O my Lord, merciful to the meek.
My mind begs for the dust of the Guru's feet.
Be kind, O God, and grant this gift:
that Nanak may live by repeating Your Name. ॥4॥11॥13॥
Devotion to the Lord of the world is his offering of incense and lamps;
in it he bows before the Creator again and again.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਗਹੀ; ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
Giving up all such rituals, he has grasped God's refuge.
By great fortune the Guru has become pleased with him. ॥1॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the universe at all hours,
ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for body and wealth are God's, and life itself is God's. ॥1॥ Rahao
Singing the Lord's praises, bliss arises within.
The Supreme Lord is all-pervading and forgiving.
In His mercy He joins His servants to His service,
and erasing the pains of birth and death, unites them with Himself. ॥2॥
This is true religious duty, this the essence of wisdom:
to repeat the Lord's Name in the Guru's company.
Cross the ocean with God's feet as your ship,
the Knower of hearts, the Creator of the world. ॥3॥
Those whom God has saved, showing His mercy,
from them the five fearsome enemies flee.
They never lose their life in the gamble of vice.
The Creator has taken Nanak's side. ॥4॥12॥14॥
In His mercy the Lord brings peace and bliss to those in His refuge.
The Supreme Lord has protected His children.
God, the Lord of the universe, is kind and merciful,
the Forgiver of all beings and creatures. ॥1॥
O God, merciful to the meek, I seek Your refuge.
O Supreme Lord, meditating on You one is ever in bliss. ॥1॥ Rahao
O God, there is none as merciful as You.
You are within every heart, pervading all.
ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਾ. ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
God adorns His servant's life in this world and the next.
O God, it is Your innate nature to purify sinners. ॥2॥
Remembering the Lord of the universe is millions of medicines.
Meditate on the Lord; this is the best charm and mantra.
Meditating on God, diseases and sorrows are erased,
and all the fruits of the heart's desire are received. ॥3॥
He is the Cause of all, all-powerful and merciful.
Reflecting on His exalted virtues is all treasures.
Nanak, God Himself has forgiven His servants.
Ever and ever meditate on the One Lord. ॥4॥13॥15॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥
Repeat the Lord's Name, O my friend,
867: and your mind will become pure.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਮਿਟੈ ਬਲਾਇ ॥
All the afflictions of mind and body are erased,
and all suffering and the darkness of attachment depart. ॥1॥
Singing the Lord's praises, one crosses the world-ocean.
By great fortune the infinite, all-pervading Lord is found. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one who sings the praises of the Lord of the world,
ਤਿਸ ਕਉ; ਪੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
His coming into the world is approved.
Turning to the Guru, come to know your Master. ॥2॥
The one who sings the Lord's praises by the Guru's grace,
his madness of lust and anger is erased.
Know the Lord to be ever present with you,
taking the perfect teaching of the perfect Guru. ॥3॥
The one who has earned the Lord's wealth and filled his storehouses
has, meeting the True Guru, set all his affairs right.
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ; ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
Through love of the Lord's Name he has become awake,
and Nanak, his mind is attached to the Lord's feet. ॥4॥14॥16॥
The Lord's feet are the ship across the terrifying world-ocean.
Remembering the Name, one does not die again and again.
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਮਤ; ਨਾਹੀ ਜਮ ਪੰਥ ॥
Singing the Lord's praises, one need not take the path of Death.
Reflection on His virtues, the highest of all reflection, destroys the five enemies. ॥1॥
O perfect Master, I have come to Your refuge.
ਜੰਤ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ; ਦੀਜਹਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Give Your hand to Your creature. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Simritis, Shastras, Vedas and Puranas
expound the virtues of the Supreme Lord.
Yogis, celibates, Vaishnavs and the followers of Ram reflect on Him,
but no one can find the limit of the imperishable Lord. ॥2॥
Shiva and the gods lament and strive,
yet they cannot understand even a bit of the invisible, unfathomable Lord.
Those to whom He Himself gives loving devotion
are very rare in the world. ॥3॥
I am without virtue; I have no virtue at all.
All treasures lie in Your glance of grace.
Meek Nanak begs for Your service.
Be merciful and grant it, O Divine Guru. ॥4॥15॥17॥
The Lord says: whoever is cursed by the saint, I uproot.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਅਕਾਸ ਤੇ ਟਾਰਉ ॥
The slanderer of the saint I bring down from the heights.
ਸੰਤ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਉ; ਅਪਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
The saint I keep with my own life.
The saint I save in that very instant. ॥1॥
He alone is a saint who is pleasing to the Lord.
ਸੰਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੈ; ਏਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The saint and the Lord of the universe have one and the same work. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਊਪਰਿ; ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
God places His hand over His saint,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਬਸੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
and dwells with His saint day and night.
With every breath God cherishes His saints.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
The one who wishes ill to the saint He casts down even from a throne. ॥2॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਕਰਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Let no one slander the saint.
ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whoever slanders falls from spiritual life.
The one whom the Creator Himself protects,
let the whole world prattle as it will. ॥3॥
The one who has come to trust his God
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
knows that soul and body are all His capital.
This faith has welled up in Nanak:
the self-willed lose, and those who turn to the Guru ever win. ॥4॥16॥18॥
Water your heart with the Immaculate Name of the Lord.
Remembering it with the tongue, sins are dispelled. ॥1॥ Rahao
868: The Lord's light shines in every heart.
Those who utter the Lord's Name do not go to hell.
Serving the Lord, they obtain all fruits. ॥1॥
Make the Lord the support of your mind.
The Lord is the ship across the world-ocean.
Uttering the Lord's Name, Death runs away.
The Lord breaks the teeth of the witch Maya. ॥2॥
The Lord is ever and ever forgiving.
The Lord brings peace and bliss to His servants,
and makes His glory manifest within them.
The Lord is mother and father to His saints. ॥3॥
Those who repeat the Lord's Name in the holy company,
and sing the Lord's praises again and again,
meeting the Guru, find the treasure beyond the reach of the senses.
Nanak, the Lord's servants hold fast to the Lord's support. ॥4॥17॥19॥
The one whom the Protector Lord wants to protect,
ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਗੁ; ਕਰੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Formless Lord takes his side. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ; ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
As fire does not harm one in the mother's womb,
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
so lust, anger, greed and attachment cannot overpower him.
In the Guru's company he meditates on the Formless Lord,
while ashes fall on the face of his slanderer. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is the servant's armour and coat of mail.
The wicked enemies cannot touch him.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰੇ; ਸੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
Whoever takes pride in his own strength is ruined.
God is the refuge of His humble servant. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
Whoever seeks the refuge of the Sovereign Lord,
ਸੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਖਿਆ; ਅਪਣੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
that servant He saves, hugging him close.
But if anyone takes great pride in himself,
ਓਹੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੁਲਤਾ; ਖਾਕੂ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
in an instant he is rolled in the dust. ॥3॥
The True Lord is, and ever shall be.
Forever and ever I am a sacrifice to Him.
In His mercy He saves His servants.
Nanak's God is the support of their breath of life. ॥4॥18॥20॥
Wondrous and utterly incomparable is the account of the Lord:
the soul is the very form of the Supreme Lord. ॥ Rahao
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬੂਢਾ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਲਾ ॥
He is neither old nor a child.
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ; ਨਹੀ ਜਮ ਜਾਲਾ ॥
No pain touches Him, nor can Death's net catch Him.
ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਨਾ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
He does not die, nor does He depart;
from the beginning, from the start of the ages, He has pervaded all. ॥1॥
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਉਸਨੁ; ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੀਤੁ ॥
The heat of vice cannot touch Him, nor the cold of worry.
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ; ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
He has no enemy and no friend, for none is His equal.
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਹਰਖੁ; ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
Neither joy nor sorrow affects Him.
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਇਸ ਕਾ; ਇਹੁ ਕਰਨੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
Everything is His creation; He is able to do all. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਇਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ; ਨਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
He has no father and no mother.
He is beyond the beyond, and has always been.
ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ; ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Neither sin nor virtue stains Him.
ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੩॥
Within every heart He is ever awake. ॥3॥
He created the one power of Maya with its three qualities;
ਮਹਾ ਮਾਇਆ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
the mighty Maya is but His shadow.
He cannot be deceived or pierced, He is unfathomable and merciful,
merciful to the meek, ever compassionate.
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
His state and extent cannot be known at all.
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧੯॥੨੧॥
Nanak is ever a sacrifice to Him. ॥4॥19॥21॥
869: I am a sacrifice to the saints.
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਰਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਉ ॥
In the saints' company I sing the Lord's praises.
By the saints' grace all sins depart.
Only the greatly fortunate come to the saints' refuge. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਕਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ॥
Chanting the Lord's Name, no obstacle can overpower one.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace one's own God is seen everywhere. ॥1॥ Rahao
When the Supreme Lord becomes merciful to someone,
He makes him the dust of the feet of the holy.
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ; ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
Lust and anger leave his body,
and the jewel of the Lord's Name comes to dwell in his mind. ॥2॥
His life becomes fruitful and approved,
who knows the Supreme Lord to be near him.
He devotes himself with loving devotion to God's praises,
and, asleep for many births in Maya, he awakens. ॥3॥
The Lord's lotus feet are the support of His servants.
I sing the praises of the Lord of the universe; this is the true trade.
He fulfils the desires of His servants.
Nanak, peace is found in the dust of the feet of His servants. ॥4॥20॥22॥6॥28॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Bow in reverence to the perfect Divine Guru,
ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ; ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
whose sight is fruitful and whose service is fruitful.
The Lord who knows all hearts, who pervades all and creates all,
in His Name's love the Guru is dyed at all hours. ॥1॥
The Guru is the form of the Lord of the universe, the Sustainer of the world,
able to protect His servant. ॥1॥ Rahao
Those in whom the Guru makes love for the Lord firm become emperors, kings and nobles of the spirit.
The wicked and proud he drives away to wander and waste.
The slanderer's mouth is afflicted with the disease of slander,
ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ; ਕਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
while all the world acclaims the one who stays in the Guru's refuge. ॥2॥
There is supreme bliss in the minds of the saints.
The saints keep the Divine Guru, the Lord, enshrined in their hearts.
The faces of those in the Guru's company become radiant,
while the slanderer loses every place, here and hereafter. ॥3॥
With every breath the servant ever praises
the Supreme Lord and the Guru who has no want.
ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ॥
In the refuge of the Guru all fears are erased,
and he casts down all the slanderers to the ground. ॥4॥
ਜਨ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Let no one slander the Guru's servant.
The servant meditates on the One Lord at all hours,
ਜਮੂਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ; ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੫॥
and Death does not come near him. ॥5॥
The servants bear no enmity, while the slanderers are proud.
The servants wish all well, while the slanderers are caught in evil thoughts.
The Guru's Sikh has meditated on the True Guru;
the servants are saved, while the slanderers cast themselves into hell. ॥6॥
Listen, my companions, my beloved friends:
these are the unfailing laws that prevail at the Lord's door:
as one does, so one receives;
the root of the proud is surely cut away. ॥7॥
O True Guru, You are the support of the unsupported.
In Your mercy You save the honour of Your servants.
Nanak says: I am a sacrifice to that Guru,
remembering whose support my honour has been saved. ॥8॥1॥29॥
870: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
Gond · Bhagat Bani · Bhagat Kabir · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
If one meets a saint, one should listen to him and ask of him.
If one meets an unholy person, it is best to stay silent. ॥1॥
O brother, what kind of words should we speak,
ਜੈਸੇ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
by which we may stay absorbed in the Lord's Name? ॥1॥ Rahao
Speaking with the saints, something of benefit comes forth;
speaking with a fool is useless prattle. ॥2॥
The more one talks with a fool, the more vice grows;
yet without speaking with the good, how can one reflect on truth? ॥3॥
Kabir says: the empty pitcher makes noise,
ਭਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ; ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ. ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ॥੪॥੧॥
but the one that is full never wavers. ॥4॥1॥
ਨਰੂ ਮਰੈ; ਨਰੁ ਕਾਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
When a man dies, his body is of no use to anyone;
when an animal dies, its body serves many purposes. ॥1॥
ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
What do I know of the course of my own deeds?
ਮੈ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਉ; ਬਾਬਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
What do I know, O brother? I never give it a thought. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਾਡ ਜਲੇ; ਜੈਸੇ ਲਕਰੀ ਕਾ ਤੂਲਾ ॥
The bones burn like a bundle of firewood,
ਕੇਸ ਜਲੇ; ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਲਾ ॥੨॥
and the hair burns like a bale of straw. ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਨਰੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥
Kabir says: man wakes from his folly only
ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ; ਮੂੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੩॥੨॥
when Death's club strikes his head. ॥3॥2॥
ਆਕਾਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ. ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਹੈ; ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇਲੇ ॥
The conscious Lord, of whom this soul is a part, pervades the sky, the netherworld, and all four directions.
ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ; ਘਟੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਗਗਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇਲੇ ॥੧॥
He is the source of bliss, ever the Supreme Being; the body perishes, but this all-pervading consciousness does not. ॥1॥
I have become detached from all else.
ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਆਇ; ਕਹਾ ਗਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This soul has come, but where can it go? It never dies. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੀਨੑੀ; ਤਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਤੇ ਕੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
The five elements combined to form the body; but from where were the elements made? From the same consciousness.
ਕਰਮ ਬਧ. ਤੁਮ ਜੀਉ ਕਹਤ ਹੌ; ਕਰਮਹਿ ਕਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਨੁ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
You say the soul is bound by its deeds; but who gave life to the deeds? ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਹੈ. ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ; ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸੋਇ ਰੇ ॥
The body exists in the Lord, and the Lord is in the body; He pervades all without a gap.
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਛੋਡਉ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਰੇ ॥੩॥੩॥
Kabir says: I will never forsake the Lord's Name; whatever happens, happens naturally by His will. ॥3॥3॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
They tied my arms and threw me down like a bundle;
the mahout in anger struck the elephant on the head.
But the elephant ran off trumpeting,
as if to say: I am a sacrifice to this beautiful one. ॥1॥
O my Lord, Yours is my strength.
The Kazi shouts: drive the elephant over him. ॥1॥ Rahao
The Kazi says: O mahout, I will cut you to pieces;
strike the elephant and drive it on.
But the elephant does not move; it seems absorbed in meditation,
as if the Lord dwells in its heart. ॥2॥
What offence had this servant of the Lord committed,
that they bound me in a bundle and threw me before the elephant?
The elephant lifts the bundle again and again and bows to it,
but the Kazi, in the darkness of his bigotry, did not understand. ॥3॥
